items.reason: A gentle, active-free cleanser keeps young skin feeling clean without stripping it.
A light ceramide moisturizer supports the skin's comfort and softness, with no active ingredients.
Mineral SPF 50 each morning helps keep existing dark marks from looking more noticeable.

response.routine_note: Cleanse morning and evening, moisturize, and apply sunscreen every morning, reapplying if outdoors for long. We have left out active serums, peels and exfoliants because they are not suited to children under 13, so if the dark marks or skin concerns persist, please ask a parent or guardian to book a visit with a pediatrician or dermatologist.
